result:
I graded submission s1 for quiz 0001 and wrote the grades to `grades/0001-s1.json`. You got 2 correct, 2 partial and 2 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | wrong | The model only writes text. Its output is a request naming `check_calendar` with the machine and date. The program runs the tool. |
| q3 | correct | A step limit is the right safeguard when the agent repeats a failing step. |
| q4 | wrong | The answer is 4. The program runs the three tools. The model is called once for the question and once for each of the three results. |
| q5 | partial | "Sends it back to the model" is the right half. You left out the why: the model needs the result to choose its next step or write the answer. |
| q6 | partial | The model picks a tool from the names and descriptions it is given. But it does not remember earlier sessions on its own. The program has to save that and put it back into the input. |

You understand the loop and its stopping condition. The idea to fix is who does what. The model only writes text, including its tool requests. The program runs the tools and calls the model again with each result, so every step is a separate model call.

I also wrote learning record 0003 and updated `NOTES.md` with these open points.

**Next step:** redo the laser-cutter trace on paper in two columns, "model writes" and "program does", and count the model calls. Then we can start context and memory. I haven't graded s2 yet. I can do that next if you want.
